issues.display_title: Issue #1104: Blue Line: load tours, panoramas and links from GoThru through the Floormap API
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Blue Line (PRD #1082) has run on fixtures since #1092 (src/lib/blueLine/mockTours.ts). Real reads now exist on the GoThru API, and they reach the FE through the Floormap API: GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#188. This task replaces the fixtures with those reads and adds a "not connected to GoThru" state.

BE endpoints (from #188, all need the Floormap session)

Endpoint Feeds
GET /v1/gothru/tours?type=blueline&page&limit&search&sort_by dashboard list, search, sort, pagination
GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas editor panorama markers
GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/links editor blue lines

A 409 gothru_not_connected means the user has no usable GoThru token.

Field mapping (BlueLineTour / PanoramaNode)

Fixture field Source Note
tourKey tour_key Can be empty (?? '' in ListToursAction), so route by moderation_id instead
name, placeId, address, lat, lng, lastEditedAt business_name, place_id, place_address, lat, lng, last_save
card thumbnail thumb
statsKey ❌ not in the list Only /v1/tours/detail has it, and that GET inserts a hosted-tour row when none exists, so we don't call it. Hide the embed link in Share.
ownerEmail ❌ The list holds only the signed-in user's tours, so use their email
PanoramaNode.id, lat, lng id, lat/lng lat/lng arrive as strings; convert to numbers
PanoramaNode.name ❌ Label by sequence ("Panorama 3")
rotationDeg ❌ /locations has no heading Start at 0
thumbnailUrl ❌ Placeholder
connections links = coordinate pairs, no panorama ids Match each end to the panorama with the same lat/lng. Panoramas at (0,0) or sharing coordinates are ambiguous, so skip those links.

Scope

  1. Server actions in src/actions/blueLine.ts that call the three endpoints with the session token, like the other actions. Pure mapping goes in src/lib/blueLine/.
  2. /dashboard/blueline: the real list, with the existing search/sort/pagination wired to the query params, plus loading and error states.
  3. The editor route is keyed by moderation_id (/dashboard/blueline/[mid]). Markers come from /panoramas, lines from /links. The header (name, address) comes from the list row the user clicked. On a direct load, fall back to a generic title, because GoThru has no read-only detail by mid.
  4. Not connected (409): the list page shows a "Connect GoThru" card instead of the tours. Its button calls the existing startGothruLogin("/dashboard/blueline"). With an active GoThru SSO session the user comes back without a password prompt, and the BE stores a fresh token on that sign-in.
  5. Edits stay local: nudge/rotate/scale are not saved, because no save endpoint exists (PRD R28). Delete the fixture file unless a test or the design preview still needs it.

Blocked by

  • GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#188 merged and deployed.
  • The GoThru API allowing client floormap / floormap-dev (see #188). Until then every user sees "Connect GoThru", and connecting doesn't help.

To ask the GoThru API team (not blocking this task)

  • Panorama id pairs in /v2/panoramas/links (today it returns coordinates only).
  • Heading (4_fov) and name in /v1/panoramas/locations.
  • An endpoint to save panorama lat/lng/heading (PRD R28).

Out of scope

  • Saving panorama edits, Clone, and Share by statsKey. These need GoThru endpoints that don't exist yet.
  • Connecting a GoThru account whose email differs from the Floormap account. "Connect GoThru" signs in through GoThru, so it can land the user in a different Floormap account.

Acceptance criteria

  • The dashboard lists the signed-in user's Blue Line tours from GoThru, and search, sort and pagination go through the API.
  • The editor shows each tour's panoramas at their real positions, with the blue lines between them.
  • Without a GoThru token the page shows Connect GoThru. After connecting, the list loads.
  • A GoThru or BE failure shows an error state, not the fixtures.
  • No GoThru token ever reaches the browser.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1111: Blue Line editor: stop presenting the placeholder Save as saved
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1103, answer 2 on #1110: placement edits and Save are on hold until the GoThru API has an endpoint that stores panorama positions.

The Blue Line editor's Save is a placeholder (BlueLineEditorView.tsx: setTimeout, then "Saved"). It tells the user their edits are stored when nothing is, and every change is gone after a reload.

Scope

  • The Save button is disabled. Its tooltip explains that saving isn't available yet.
  • The status next to it no longer claims "Saved". When there are edits, it says they are not stored.
  • Edits keep working locally (move, rotate, scale, reset, undo/redo), as today.

Acceptance criteria

  • Nothing in the editor says an edit was saved.
  • The Save button can't be pressed, and says why.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1112: Blue Line dashboard: 'View All Blue Line Tours on One Map' offer with Contact Support
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1103: R10–R13, placement per answer 12 on #1110.

Scope

Add an offer section to the Blue Line dashboard.

  • Title: View All Blue Line Tours on One Map
  • Description: Need to view all your Blue Line tours together on one map? Contact our Support team to learn more.
  • CTA: Contact Support, which opens mailto:support@gothru.co.

Placement: below the existing banner (GoThruBanner, in the right-hand column) on wide screens. That column is hidden on smaller screens, so there the section goes above the tour list. It is informational and doesn't interrupt the list.

The design follows the existing Blue Line style (answer 3).

Acceptance criteria

  • Wide screens: the section is directly below the banner.
  • Smaller screens: the section is above the tour list.
  • Contact Support opens an email to support@gothru.co.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1113: Blue Line editor: windowed panorama list and map focus on the picked panorama
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1103: R28–R30, and Risk 3 (selecting many tours makes the panorama list long).

Today the editor sidebar renders every panorama row. Selecting a panorama re-renders all of them: about 300 ms at 3000 panoramas in dev (measured for #1108). Also, picking a panorama in the list only highlights it; the map doesn't move to it.

Scope

  • Windowed list: the sidebar panorama list renders only the rows in view, plus a small buffer. Search and selection work as today.
  • Map focus: selecting a panorama in the list moves the map to it, if it's placed. Selecting on the map doesn't move the map.
  • No new dependency.

Acceptance criteria

  • With thousands of panoramas, the list scrolls smoothly, and selecting a row no longer re-renders every row.
  • Picking a panorama in the list centres the map on it.
  • Search still filters the list.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1114: Blue Line dashboard: Edit Multiple Tours selection
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1103: R1–R9, with answers 4–6 on #1110.

Scope

  • Toggle: an Edit Multiple Tours toggle near the tour list controls. It is off each time the dashboard opens and isn't remembered (answer 6). When off, the list is exactly as today (R2).
  • When the toggle is on:
    • A checkbox appears on each tour.
    • Select All selects all tours matching the current search, across every page (answer 4).
    • "{count} tours selected" is always visible, with a Clear action.
  • Selection survives changes: selections stay when the search, sort or page changes (answer 5). Nothing looks selected that isn't.
  • Edit: enabled when at least one tour is selected. It opens the multiple-tour editor (separate task) with the selected tours.
  • The single-tour flow is unchanged: clicking a tour still opens the single-tour editor (R33–R34).

Acceptance criteria

  • Toggle off: no checkboxes, and the list behaves as today.
  • Toggle on: checkboxes, Select All (across pages, for the current search), the count, Clear.
  • Edit is disabled with nothing selected, and opens the multiple editor with the selection.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #1115: Blue Line: multiple-tour editor (view only)
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1103: R14–R30, with answers 2, 3 and 7–10 on #1110. It is view only (answer 2): placement editing and Save wait for a GoThru endpoint.

Scope

  • Layout: the multiple-tour editor reuses the Blue Line editor layout (nav, sidebar, map, bottom bar). It opens from the dashboard's Edit action with the selected tours.
  • Sidebar: the Blue Line Tours section shows the total panorama count and a Select Tour selector, with All (the default) plus each tour.
    • All: every selected tour's panoramas and links are on the map and in the list. No tour metadata is shown.
    • One tour: only that tour's panoramas and links, its count, and its Tour Information (Tour Name, Tour Key, Place ID, Owner Name).
  • Colors: each tour gets its own colour for dots and lines, shown next to its name in the selector (answer 7).
  • Count: the panorama count is the total (answer 8).
  • Map focus: switching the selector fits the map to that tour; All fits to all of them (answer 9).
  • Failed tours: a tour that can't be loaded is skipped. A notice names it, and the rest open (answer 10).
  • Panorama Nodes: search and the list follow the current selection. Picking a panorama shows it on the map.
  • No editing: placement tools and Save are not offered.
  • The single-tour editor is unchanged (R33–R34).

Depends on

  • #1114, the dashboard multi-select (Edit action).
  • #1113, the windowed panorama list.
  • Owner Name, and customers' tours from the published Google Street View account (answer 1b), come with the API spike, GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#194. Until then, the owner is the signed-in user.

Acceptance criteria

  • Opening from Edit loads every selected tour, and All is the default.
  • The All view and the one-tour view show the right panoramas, links, counts and metadata, and fit the map.
  • Tours are coloured distinctly, with the colour shown in the selector.
  • A tour that fails to load is named in a notice, and the others open.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.
